title: Employing Aeroponic Systems for the Clonal Propagation of Cannabis
protocol: Select a healthy, female mother plant exhibiting desirable characteristics.
Allow the mother plant to reach an appropriate size for clonal propagation, with roughly 25 mature shoots.
Maintain the mother plants in the vegetative growth stage under 18 hours of light and 6 hours of dark conditions.
Position the lid on top of the container (38.1 cm x 25.4 cm x 30.48 cm).
Drill holes into the lid, ensuring at least 3 cm space between each hole.
Place the water pump in the center of the container.
Pour 7-8 L of distilled water into the container to ensure the pump nozzle is approximately 2.5 cm above the waterline.
Insert Rockwool cubes or media cubes of choice into each slot on the lid.
Turn on the water pump and allow it to run for 24 hours.
Select appropriate shoots from the mother plant for excising.
Collect shoots near the apical meristem using a sterilized scalpel or scissors.
Cut the stem at a 45° angle.
Remove all foliage except that on the top three nodes.
Make a small slit (1-2 cm) in the middle of the 45° cut, if desired.
Dip the cutting into the rooting solution containing IBA for ~5 s.
Insert the cutting into the center of a Rockwool cube positioned in the aeroponic system to a depth of ~1-2 cm from the bottom.
Spray unrooted cuttings with the nutrient mist solution every 3 days.
Grow cuttings with 18-24 h of light per day and a PPFD of 100 µmol/m²/s at 24-29 °C and 40-60% relative humidity.
Replenish the system with water at a pH between 5.0-6.0 every 2-5 days.
Lightly mist cuttings (one mist per cutting) with the nutrient mist solution every 3 days.
Add 5 mL of each nutrient solution to the reservoir every 3-5 days.
Add 15 mL of the algae and bacteria cleaning solution containing hypochlorous acid (0.028%) per 10 L of water every 5 days.
Select cuttings with long, white, fibrous roots for transplanting.
Dislodge the Rockwool cube from the system carefully.
Untangle the roots.
Transplant the Cannabis propagules to a 4 L nursery pot filled with nutritious soil mix.
Water immediately after transplantation to prevent root drying.
Wash the aeroponic system with water when no longer in use.
Clean the system with 70% ethanol or another disinfectant.
Remove and rinse the filter from the water pump with water to remove debris.
Dry the system by wiping it down with paper towels or a washcloth.
Place the pump inside the tub with the lid on for storage.
